name: Barbell Single-Arm Landmine Press
steps: Face a bar secured at its far end and hold the free end at one shoulder.
Brace your trunk and drive the bar up and forward with that arm.
Return the end of the bar to your shoulder.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Keep your hips and shoulders square to the anchor rather than leaning back as you press.
Keep your wrist stacked straight behind the end of the bar throughout the arc.
